question: Should this private catalog pilot wait for an upstream EmDash release and mounted-site proof before it is merged as a supported Commerce integration?
rationale: The branch proves storage semantics but documents that the only declared released peer cannot complete the required mounted-site path, so accepting the support baseline requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Wait for the released runtime fix
options.body: Keep the PR open until EmDash releases the scheduler fix, then update the exact peer version and attach mounted-site proof.

options.title: Merge as an explicitly unsupported private experiment
options.body: Merge the private pilot without a usable released mounted-site path and defer any support or release commitment until upstream catches up.
